scenario.situation: Remote origin URL is missing or invalid
scenario.solution: Prompt user to configure git remote or manually supply owner/repo name.

scenario.situation: GitHub MCP API authentication or permission error
scenario.solution: Verify GitHub authentication settings or personal access token permissions.
Present the existing issue URL to the user and ask whether to link, comment, or override.

scenario.situation: Attempted duplicate override without Gate #1 review
scenario.solution: Block execution immediately. Even when user selects "Create new issue anyway", mandate presentation of drafted public issue Markdown and halt at Hard Stop Gate #1 before calling create_issue.

scenario.situation: Attempted global/unscoped git config setup without --local flag
scenario.solution: Reject unscoped config commands. Enforce explicit scope flag: `git config --local user.name "..."` and `git config --local user.email "..."`.

scenario.situation: Attempted use of arbitrary shell operators (&, ;, PowerShell & { ... }) or command batching across approval gates
scenario.solution: Reject shell chaining operators. Ensure sequential command batching is non-interactive, avoids banned operators, and NEVER crosses mandatory approval gates (Gate #1, Gate #2, Gate #3).
Intercept draft creation, strip acceptance criteria from public markdown payload, and retain them solely in private scratchpad.
Report test failures or unmet acceptance criteria back to the user before attempting closure.

scenario.situation: Attempted direct API or speculative/optimistic issue closure (`github.update_issue` with state closed or manual closure calls)
scenario.solution: Block execution immediately. Reiterate that issue closure is strictly forbidden as an agent-initiated action and occurs exclusively and automatically via GitHub native PR merge webhooks using plain-text keywords in the PR description.

scenario.situation: Attempted bypass of Gate #1 draft review, Gate #2 fix review, or Gate #3 pre-push review via same-turn tool invocation
scenario.solution: Halt execution immediately. Enforce strict turn separation: drafting or review generation must occur in one turn with `ask_followup_question`, and tool execution must wait until a subsequent turn following explicit user confirmation.

scenario.situation: Sub-mode (Code/Fix) attempts unauthorized git commit, push, or PR creation
scenario.solution: Reject action, return control to github-issue mode, and enforce Gate #3 human review.

scenario.situation: Attempted premature task completion before Phase 6 workspace cleanup
scenario.solution: Block completion, execute CAN_MERGE check, offer/execute PR merge, restore workspace via `git checkout main && git pull`, and delete remote feature branch.
